A girl in a school uniform kneels in a ruined corridor, her jaw clenched and brows knotted, silver light gathering in her raised palm while she hangs poised and still for half a second. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. The camera jolts violently three times, each smaller than the last, settling within half a second. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the serpent is hurled into the wall as dust slowly settles and she gasps for breath. The camera steadies.
